title: Council session
description: One question considered by one council inside one project. A session pins the definition it consulted by embedding a snapshot, so later edits to the council never rewrite what was actually asked of whom. The session is project-owned durable state; the backend's live execution state is derived from it and the browser's copy is a view.

definition_snapshot.description: A copy of the definition as it stood when the session was created. Reading it needs no lookup, and a deleted or edited council leaves the session intact.

context_snapshot.description: The selected context handed to Council at consultation time, captured once. Every initial member call in a run receives exactly these bytes.

outcomes.description: Conclusions the user chose to retain. The note is the durable artifact; this is the link back to the contribution it came from.

SessionStatus.description: draft: created, nothing run. running: a run is in flight. partial: a run finished with at least one member failed or cancelled. complete: a run produced a synthesis. cancelled/failed: terminal for the last run; the session can still take a new run. Reopening never advances this on its own.

ChatBinding.description: The explicit, persisted association between this session and a native chat. Council routes replies by this binding alone; it never infers a destination from whichever tab happens to be focused.

origin_message_id.description: The user turn that opened the consultation, when the session began from chat.

missing.description: Set when the chat could not be resolved on the last attempt. The session stays usable and read-only replies are held rather than posted somewhere else.

Run.description: One bounded execution: an independent member round plus chair synthesis, or a focused follow-up. request_id makes the run idempotent — a repeated start command with the same request_id returns the existing run instead of spending tokens again.

prompt.description: For a follow-up, the focused question. For an initial round, empty: the session question is used.

addressed_seat_id.description: Present on a follow-up aimed at one seat.

synthesis.description: The chair's answer. This is the text the chat provider returns; it is not a second transcript.

Contribution.description: One member's answer within one run, attributed to the exact member and source revisions it was produced from. A reply that arrives after the run left 'running' is recorded as 'stale' and never overwrites newer state.

model_id.description: The host model that actually answered, recorded so a result is never attributed to a model that did not produce it.

text.description: The member's answer as written. Capped at the inline ceiling: v0.1 moves whole snapshots across the host's 64 KiB IPC hop, so no single field may fill it. The chair's synthesis is a Contribution and inherits the same cap.

Claim.description: One assertion with its support label. 'source' requires at least one citation; 'inference' and 'unknown' must not carry one, so an interpretation can never be displayed as something a source said.

Failure.description: A visible failure state. 'retryable' drives whether the UI offers an explicit retry; nothing retries on its own.
